title: Case 318: Tay Chow Lyang & Tony Tan Poh Chuan

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: It was just after 2.30pm on Monday, September 15, 2003, when two ambulances turned into Barker Street, a leafy residential road in the eastern Sydney suburb of Kingsford.
sentences.zh: 2003年9月15日星期一下午2点30分刚过，两辆救护车驶入了金斯福德这条悉尼东部绿树成荫的住宅街道——巴克街。

sentences.en: The ambulances pulled up outside a red-brick two-storey duplex with a tidy front garden and low-brick fence.
sentences.zh: 救护车停在了一栋两层红砖复式公寓外，这里有着整洁的前花园和低矮的砖墙。

sentences.en: As they parked, a panic-stricken, dishevelled young man with his jumper on inside-out raced towards them.
sentences.zh: 它们停下时，一名惊恐万分、衣衫凌乱、毛衣穿反了的年轻男子朝它们冲了过来。

sentences.en: The man was 24-year-old Ram Tiwari.
sentences.zh: 这名男子是24岁的拉姆·蒂瓦里。

sentences.en: Ram lived on the second floor of the duplex with his two 26-year-old flatmates,
sentences.zh: 拉姆和他的两个26岁室友住在该复式公寓的二楼，

sentences.en: Tae Chao Leung and Tony Tan Po Chawan.
sentences.zh: 他们是谢朝梁和陈保川（音译）。

sentences.en: All three were engineering students from Singapore attending classes at the nearby University of New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 这三人都是来自新加坡的工程系学生，在附近的在新南威尔士大学上课。

sentences.en: Upon seeing Ram, the paramedics quickly locked their doors.
sentences.zh: 一看到拉姆，医护人员便迅速锁上了车门。

sentences.en: They were understandably on edge, having been called to the property about a suspected double homicide.
sentences.zh: 他们接到报警称该处发生疑似双重凶杀案，感到紧张也是情理之中。

sentences.en: One of the paramedics rolled her window down a crack to hear what Ram had to say.
sentences.zh: 其中一名医护人员将车窗摇开一条缝，想听听拉姆要说些什么。

sentences.en: He looked bewildered and was clearly in a state of distress.
sentences.zh: 他看起来茫然不知所措，显然处于极度痛苦的状态。

sentences.en: Ram told the paramedics that he was the one who'd called for help.
sentences.zh: 拉姆告诉医护人员，是他打了求救电话。

sentences.en: Through heavy breaths, Ram explained that he'd found one of his flatmates on the floor, bloody and frothing at the mouth.
sentences.zh: 拉姆大口喘着粗气解释说，他发现其中一个室友倒在地上，浑身是血，口吐白沫。

sentences.en: As he spoke, the paramedics noted that Ram seemed distracted by the sight of his own hands and kept looking down at them.
sentences.zh: 他说话时，医护人员注意到拉姆似乎被自己的双手分散了注意力，并不停地低头看着它们。

sentences.en: They were smeared with blood.
sentences.zh: 它们的上面沾满了血迹。

sentences.en: Police arrived on Barker Street moments later.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，警察赶到了巴克街。

sentences.en: As they made their way towards the duplex, Ram Tiwari struggled to make sense of what he'd seen.
sentences.zh: 当他们走向复式公寓时，拉姆·蒂瓦里还在努力回想自己所看到的恐怖场景。

sentences.en: The 24-year-old student, who was born in India but raised in Brunei and Singapore, had been in Australia for just over three years.
sentences.zh: 这名24岁的学生出生于印度，但在文莱和新加坡长大，在澳大利亚呆了刚满三年。

sentences.en: He'd been granted a mechanical engineering scholarship by the Singaporean Armed Forces after completing his national service.
sentences.zh: 他在完成国民服役后，获得了新加坡武装部队颁发的机械工程奖学金。

sentences.en: To supplement his scholarship, Ram worked part-time as a security guard, which meant he often caught up on sleep during the day.
sentences.zh: 为了补贴奖学金，拉姆兼职做保安，这意味着他经常在白天补觉。

sentences.en: Ram told the first responding sergeant that he'd been sleeping in his bedroom when the sounds of the television blaring in the lounge room and something falling woke him.
sentences.zh: 拉姆告诉第一批赶到的警长，他当时正在卧室睡觉，被客厅里震耳欲聋的电视声和什么东西坠落的声音吵醒了。

sentences.en: Thinking one of his flatmates had simply dropped something, he went back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他以为只是哪个室友掉了东西，便又睡着了。

sentences.en: Sometime later, Ram woke again to a commotion.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，拉姆被一阵骚动再次吵醒。

sentences.en: Over the loud volume of the TV, he heard someone run past his bedroom door.
sentences.zh: 透过巨大的电视音量，他听到有人跑过他的卧室门外。

sentences.en: Ram thought he heard his flatmate, Tony Tan Po Chawan, scream help, but he couldn't be sure.
sentences.zh: 拉姆觉得自己听到室友陈保川大喊救命，但他无法确定。

sentences.en: Then, someone pounded on Ram's door.
sentences.zh: 接着，有人砰砰敲击拉姆的门。

sentences.en: Ram's first thought was that someone was attempting to break in.
sentences.zh: 拉姆的第一反应是有人在试图破门而入。

sentences.en: Then, he heard a loud bang as though metal was being hit against something.
sentences.zh: 随后，他听到一声巨响，就像是金属撞击什么东西的声音。

sentences.en: This noise continued for what felt like several minutes.
sentences.zh: 这种噪音持续了感觉有好几分钟。

sentences.en: Still suspecting a break-in, Ram locked his bedroom door from the inside until the sound finally stopped.
sentences.zh: 拉姆仍然怀疑有强行入室者，便从里面锁上了卧室门，直到声音终于停下来。

sentences.en: He waited a while before opening his door and peering out into the hall.
sentences.zh: 他等了一会儿，才打开门向走廊张望。

sentences.en: To his left, he saw that the back door in the lounge room was slightly ajar.
sentences.zh: 在他左边，他看到客厅的后门虚掩着。

sentences.en: To his right, Tony was slumped next to the front door with his back against the wall, his bloodied head resting on his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 在他右边，保川瘫倒在前门旁，背靠着墙，血迹斑斑的头搭在胸前。

sentences.en: Blood had pooled around him and a baseball bat and kitchen knife lay by his side.
sentences.zh: 他周围血流成河，身旁放着一根棒球棍和一把厨房菜刀。

sentences.en: Terrified that whoever had hurt Tony was still in the apartment,
sentences.zh: 由于害怕伤害保川的人仍然在公寓里，

sentences.en: Ram picked up the bat for protection and made his way to the back door.
sentences.zh: 拉姆拿起球棒防身，朝后门走去。

sentences.en: That was when he saw his other flatmate, Tae Chao Leung, lying behind the lounge room couch, his head completely bashed in, and blood everywhere.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他看到他的另一个室友谢朝梁躺在客厅沙发后面，头部完全被打烂，到处都是血。

sentences.en: Ram quickly closed and locked the back door, then raced back to his bedroom with the bat.
sentences.zh: 拉姆迅速关上并锁好后门，然后拿着球棒跑回卧室。

sentences.en: He locked himself in, pulling a captain across the door as a barricade, and used his mobile phone to call emergency services.
sentences.zh: 他把自己反锁在里面，把一张凳子拉到门后作为路障，并用手机拨打了紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: Ram told the operator,
sentences.zh: 拉姆告诉接线员：

sentences.en: I need the ambulance and the police.
sentences.zh: 我需要救护车和警察。

sentences.en: There's been a murder.
sentences.zh: 发生谋杀案了。

sentences.en: My two friends are lying dead outside.
sentences.zh: 我的两个朋友倒在外面的血泊中。

sentences.en: There's blood all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是血。

sentences.en: The operator asked exactly what had happened.
sentences.zh: 接线员询问到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Ram replied,
sentences.zh: 拉姆回答：

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I was asleep and I heard this screaming.
sentences.zh: 我在睡觉，然后我听到尖叫声。

sentences.en: When I turned, my two friends are dead.
sentences.zh: 当我转身时，我的两个朋友已经死了。

sentences.en: He said there was a baseball bat and a knife at the scene.
sentences.zh: 他说现场有一根棒球棍和一把刀。

sentences.en: The operator told Ram to stay put and wait for help to arrive.
sentences.zh: 接线员告诉拉姆待在原地不要动，等待救援人员到达。

sentences.en: She then asked if his flatmates were definitely dead or possibly just unconscious.
sentences.zh: 她接着问他的室友是确定已经死亡还是可能只是昏迷不醒。

sentences.en: Ram said there was too much blood to tell.
sentences.zh: 拉姆说血太多了，分不清。

sentences.en: The operator asked if Ram knew CPR.
sentences.zh: 接线员问拉姆是否懂得心肺复苏术。

sentences.en: He was well versed in CPR from his time in the military, but he didn't want to try.
sentences.zh: 他在军队期间对心肺复苏术很精通，但他不想尝试。

sentences.en: Both Tony and Chao Leung's faces were so severely covered in blood that he didn't think he could do it.
sentences.zh: 托尼和朝梁的脸上都血肉模糊，他觉得自己做不到。

sentences.en: The operator asked Ram if it was safe for him to go back out and check if his flatmates were still breathing.
sentences.zh: 接线员问拉姆现在出去查看室友是否还有呼吸是否安全。

sentences.en: Terror audible in his voice, Ram replied,
sentences.zh: 声音中透着恐惧，拉姆回答道：

sentences.en: I'm not going back outside till somebody gets here.
sentences.zh: 在有人来之前，我不会出去的。

sentences.en: I'm not fucking going back outside.
sentences.zh: 我他妈才不出去呢。

sentences.en: You want to break down the door?
sentences.zh: 你想破门吗？

sentences.en: Fucking go ahead.
sentences.zh: 他妈的尽管来吧。

sentences.en: I'm not fucking going back outside.
sentences.zh: 我他妈才不出去呢。

sentences.en: When the operator told Ram that the paramedics had arrived, he took the bat and left his room.
sentences.zh: 当接线员告诉拉姆医护人员已经到达时，他拿着球棒离开了房间。

sentences.en: He walked up to Tony and saw foam around his mouth and bleeding from his head.
sentences.zh: 他走向保川，看到他嘴边有白沫，头部在流血。

sentences.en: He touched Tony's neck, but couldn't feel a pulse.
sentences.zh: 他摸了摸保川的脖子，但摸不到脉搏。

sentences.en: Tony wasn't breathing either.
sentences.zh: 保川也没有呼吸了。

sentences.en: Not wanting to do anything else, Ram left the house via the back door and went to tell the waiting paramedics and police what had happened.
sentences.zh: 不想再做其他任何事，拉姆从后门离开房子，去告诉正在等待的医护人员和警察发生了什么。

sentences.en: In addition to being incredibly shaken by what he'd seen, Ram voiced disappointment in himself for not going outside when he heard Tony yell for help.
sentences.zh: 除了被自己看到的景象吓得魂飞魄散之外，拉姆还对自己在听到托尼呼救时没有出门感到懊恼。

sentences.en: I didn't go out, he told the sergeant on the scene.
sentences.zh: 我没有出去，他向现场的警长坦言。

sentences.en: I should have, but didn't.
sentences.zh: 我本该出去的，但没有。

sentences.en: After I heard somebody being hit, I should have opened the door.
sentences.zh: 在我听到有人被打后，我本应该开门的。

sentences.en: But didn't.
sentences.zh: 但没有。

sentences.en: Police climbed the small flight of stairs at the front of the duplex.
sentences.zh: 警察爬上了复式住宅正面的几级小台阶。

sentences.en: While the lower level was occupied by the property's landlords,
sentences.zh: 底层由房东居住，

sentences.en: the second floor served as a convenient sharehouse for students attending the nearby University of New South Wales Kensington campus.
sentences.zh: 二楼则是一个方便的合租房，供就读于附近新南威尔士大学肯辛顿校区的学生居住。

sentences.en: It was a modest abode, with four bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, and a lounge room.
sentences.zh: 这是一处简朴的住所，有四个卧室、一个厨房、一个浴室和一个客厅。

sentences.en: The front door opened to a small hallway that the rooms stemmed from, with the lounge room at the end of the hall.
sentences.zh: 前门通向一条小走廊，各个房间由此延伸，走廊尽头是客厅。

sentences.en: The back door in the lounge room opened to a small veranda and a second set of external stairs.
sentences.zh: 客厅的后门通向一个小阳台和第二组室外楼梯。

sentences.en: These led down to the concrete backyard which housed the rubbish bins and other facilities.
sentences.zh: 这些楼梯通向铺有混凝土的后院，后院里放着垃圾桶和其他设施。

sentences.en: The home's decor was bland, with bare white walls, white floors, and cheap furnishings.
sentences.zh: 家里的装修很单调，光秃秃的白墙、白色的地板和廉价的家具。

sentences.en: When the police reached the top of the stairs, they found the front door closed but unlocked.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达楼梯顶端时，他们发现前门关着但没有反锁。

sentences.en: The body of 26-year-old Tony Tan Pochawan lay slumped against it in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 26岁的陈保川的尸体倒在血泊中，靠在门边。

sentences.en: The officers had to push him aside to gain access.
sentences.zh: 警员们不得不把他推到一边才能进去。

sentences.en: Tony's head had been so severely bashed that parts of his brain were visible.
sentences.zh: 保川的头部遭受了极其严重的重击，部分大脑清晰可见。

sentences.en: He had also been stabbed multiple times in the neck, presumably with the black-handled kitchen knife lying under his right leg.
sentences.zh: 他的颈部也被刺了多刀，推测是用他右腿下方的黑色手柄厨房菜刀刺的。

sentences.en: One of the wounds was so deep that it had punctured his voice box.
sentences.zh: 其中一处伤口极深，刺穿了他的喉部。

sentences.en: Blood was smeared all over the wall and across the doorframe.
sentences.zh: 血迹涂抹在墙壁和门框各处。

sentences.en: The police followed a trail of blood down the hallway towards the lounge room and found Tony's prescription eyeglasses smashed to pieces, along with several of his shattered teeth.
sentences.zh: 警察沿着走廊的血迹走向客厅，发现了被砸得粉碎的保川的处方眼镜，以及他好几颗碎裂的牙齿。

sentences.en: Blood spatter, smears, and bloody footprints marked the lounge room floor, couch, and coffee table.
sentences.zh: 客厅的地板、沙发和茶几上布满了血迹、血斑和带血的脚印。

sentences.en: The lounge room was sparsely furnished, with nothing more than a beige couch, a canvas deck chair, a coffee table, and a small television sitting on a flat-packed stand.
sentences.zh: 客厅陈设简陋，只有一个米色沙发、一张帆布躺椅、一张茶几和一个放在平板组装电视柜上的小型电视。

sentences.en: Behind the couch, a makeshift desk sat low to the ground with a computer and other equipment on top, the back door to its left.
sentences.zh: 沙发后面是一个贴地的简易书桌，上面放着一台电脑和其他设备，左边是后门。

sentences.en: As police approached, they could see that the couch and deck chair were splattered with blood and appeared to have been pushed slightly out of place.
sentences.zh: 当警察走近时，他们看到沙发和躺椅上溅满了血迹，并且似乎被稍微挪动了位置。

sentences.en: Behind the couch, 26-year-old Tae Chao Leung lay in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 在沙发后面，26岁的谢朝梁倒在一片血泊中。

sentences.en: Like Tony, he had sustained numerous blows to the head as well as multiple stab wounds to the neck.
sentences.zh: 和托尼一样，他的头部遭受了多次重击，脖子上也有多处刺伤。

sentences.en: On the other side of the room, the TV blared at high volume.
sentences.zh: 房间的另一头，电视正开着大音量播放。

sentences.en: Ram Tiwari was taken to the police station where he voluntarily gave two detectives a more detailed statement in an electronically recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 拉姆·蒂瓦里被带到警察局，在那里他自愿向两名侦探提供了一份更详细的证词，并进行了电子录音访谈。

sentences.en: Ram couldn't think of anyone who would possibly want to hurt Tony or Chao Leung.
sentences.zh: 拉姆想不出任何人会想要伤害保川或朝梁。

sentences.en: Both of them were dedicated electrical engineering students who spent the majority of their time focusing on their studies, living relatively quiet lives in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都是敬业的电气工程专业学生，把大部分时间都花在学业上，在澳大利亚过着相对平静的生活。

sentences.en: Like Ram, Tony was completing his degree thanks to a scholarship from the Singaporean Armed Forces.
sentences.zh: 和拉姆一样，托尼也是凭借新加坡武装部队的奖学金完成学业的。

sentences.en: He'd taken his education seriously as he'd hoped to secure a good military career that could help him provide for his parents.
sentences.zh: 他非常看重自己的教育，希望能获得一份好的军事职业，从而能够赡养父母。

sentences.en: Having already fulfilled his national service and completed a diploma in architectural technology, Tony hoped to rise to the rank of major by the time he was 30.
sentences.zh: 托尼已经完成了国民服役并获得了建筑技术文凭，他希望在30岁时晋升为少校。

sentences.en: Chao Leung's university tuition was paid by his parents, who worked as food vendors back in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 朝梁的大学学费由他的父母支付，他们是在新加坡经营食品小贩的劳动者。

sentences.en: He was a computer whiz who happily spent his spare time online or at home watching movies.
sentences.zh: 他是个电脑奇才，闲暇时间高高兴兴地泡在网上或在家看电影。

sentences.en: While Tony had gone out with Ram on a few occasions, Chao Leung's English was limited and he associated almost exclusively with other Singaporean or Asian students.
sentences.zh: 虽然托尼曾和拉姆一起外出过几次，但朝梁的英语有限，他几乎只与新加坡或其他亚洲学生交往。

sentences.en: Neither had any known enemies, nor were they involved with drugs, criminal activity, or any shady characters.
sentences.zh: 两人都没有已知的敌人，也没有涉足毒品、犯罪活动或任何可疑人物。

sentences.en: Ram explained to the detectives that the previous evening of Sunday September 14 had been uneventful.
sentences.zh: 拉姆向侦探解释说，前一天9月14日星期日过得很平淡。

sentences.en: After working a security shift in the day, he'd returned home at around 6pm and watched the fantasy adventure film Lord of the Rings with Tony and Chao Leung.
sentences.zh: 白天值完保安班后，他在傍晚6点左右回到家，和托尼、朝梁一起观看了奇幻冒险电影《指环王》。

sentences.en: The trio had made a few passing comments about the film, but nothing of note was discussed.
sentences.zh: 三个人对这部电影顺便评论了几句，但没有谈论什么重要的事情。

sentences.en: Ram was exhausted, having worked all weekend.
sentences.zh: 拉姆精疲力竭，整个周末都在工作。

sentences.en: He was the first to go to bed at around 9.30pm, at which point everything was normal.
sentences.zh: 他是第一个去睡觉的人，大约在晚上9点半，当时一切都很正常。

sentences.en: Ram woke up at around 6.30am on Monday to a phone call from his girlfriend, Elvira.
sentences.zh: 周一早上6点半左右，拉姆被女朋友埃尔维拉的一个电话吵醒。

sentences.en: They spoke for about half an hour, during which they arranged to meet at uni at 2pm that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 他们通话了大约半小时，期间他们约好当天下午2点在学校见面。

sentences.en: Ram got up, ate breakfast and had a shower, but then went back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 拉姆起床、吃早饭并洗了个澡，但随后又回去睡觉了。

sentences.en: He didn't know what time it was when he'd first woken up to the TV blaring and the sound of something falling,
sentences.zh: 他不知道自己第一次被电视轰鸣声和东西掉落的声音吵醒时是几点，

sentences.en: but the noise had been so innocuous that he hadn't even considered getting up to see what it was.
sentences.zh: 但那个噪音太微不足道了，他甚至没有考虑起床去看看是什么情况。

sentences.en: It was only when he'd woken for the second time at around 2.10pm that he heard the banging sound and screams in the hallway and realised something was horribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 直到下午2点10分左右第二次醒来时，他听到走廊里传来砰砰的撞击声和尖叫声，才意识到出了大问题。

sentences.en: He repeated the same story he'd given the emergency services operator and the first responding sergeant about how he'd discovered his flatmate's bodies.
sentences.zh: 他重复了之前对紧急服务接线员和第一批赶到的警长说过的话，讲述了他是如何发现室友尸体的。

sentences.en: Ram told the detectives that on his way out to meet the paramedics, he went up to Tony and touched his neck to feel for a pulse.
sentences.zh: 拉姆告诉侦探，在出门迎接医护人员的路上，他走到保川身边，摸了摸他的脖子以感受脉搏。

sentences.en: He then put his hand to Tony's nose to see if he was breathing.
sentences.zh: 然后他把手放到保川的鼻子前，看他是否还在呼吸。

sentences.en: He noticed that Tony was frothing at the mouth.
sentences.zh: 他注意到保川正在口吐白沫。

sentences.en: The blood was falling out of Tony's nose and air too, Ram recalled.
sentences.zh: 拉姆回忆说，血液和空气一起从保川的鼻子流了出来。

sentences.en: Back at Barker Street, Ram took detectives on a walkthrough of the crime scene to explain exactly what he'd seen when he emerged from his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 回到巴克街，拉姆带着侦探重走了一遍犯罪现场，详细解释了他从卧室出来时所看到的一切。

sentences.en: He added that when he checked Tony, a spurt of blood had come out of his mouth and he'd, quote, sort of spasmed.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，当他检查保川时，一股血从他嘴里喷涌而出，并且他，引用他的话说，“有点痉挛抽搐”。

sentences.en: While the black-handled kitchen knife was a generic model that could have come from anywhere,
sentences.zh: 虽然黑色手柄的厨房菜刀是一个随处可见的普通款式，

sentences.en: Ram explained that the baseball bat found next to Tony's body actually belonged to him.
sentences.zh: 但拉姆解释说，在保川尸体旁发现的棒球棍其实是他的。

sentences.en: He'd purchased it just two days earlier from a sports store in the city, but hadn't had a chance to use it yet.
sentences.zh: 他两天前刚从市里的一家体育用品商店买下它，但一直没有机会使用。

sentences.en: Despite a thorough examination of the property, investigators found no clues as to who the killer or killers might be.
sentences.zh: 尽管对该物业进行了彻底的检查，但调查人员没有找到任何关于凶手可能是谁的线索。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry, nor was there any blood or other evidence outside the property to indicate where the perpetrator had fled to.
sentences.zh: 没有强行进入的迹象，物业外面也没有血迹或其他证据来表明行凶者逃往了何处。

sentences.en: Five sets of fingerprints were found throughout the home that couldn't be attributed to one of the tenants or their known guests.
sentences.zh: 屋里发现了五组指纹，无法归咎于任何租户或他们已知的访客。

sentences.en: These prints were put through the police database, but didn't match anyone in the system.
sentences.zh: 这些指纹被输入警察数据库，但与系统中的任何人都不匹配。

sentences.en: The baseball bat and a knife were forensically examined, but no usable prints were found.
sentences.zh: 对棒球棍和一把刀进行了法医检查，但没有发现可用的指纹。

sentences.en: Albert Leescher was the landlord who lived on the ground floor of the Barker Street duplex.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯特·利舍尔是住在巴克街复式公寓底层的房东。

sentences.en: He told police that he and his wife had been in and out of the property throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，他和妻子整天都在房产进进出出。

sentences.en: They kept the side gates locked until they returned at around 1.45pm.
sentences.zh: 他们锁上了侧门，直到下午1点45分左右返回。

sentences.en: Albert said he'd sat down to eat his lunch at 1.50pm, but didn't hear any of the commotion taking place upstairs.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯特说他在下午1点50分坐下来吃午饭，但没有听到楼上发生的任何骚动。

sentences.en: The only person he saw run past the back window was Ram Tiwari, on his way to greet the first responders.
sentences.zh: 他唯一看到跑过背面窗户的人是拉姆·蒂瓦里，当时他正赶去迎接第一批救援人员。

sentences.en: The next step for investigators was to look into Chia Liang and Tony's movements on the day of the crime.
sentences.zh: 调查人员的下一步是调查家亮和托尼在案发当天的行踪。

sentences.en: The pair had been close friends ever since Tony moved into the Barker Street apartment several months prior.
sentences.zh: 自从几个月前托尼搬进巴克街公寓以来，两人就一直是密友。

sentences.en: Because they were both completing the same degree, they were known to be more or less inseparable around the university.
sentences.zh: 因为他们攻读相同的学位，所以在学校里几乎形影不离，这是众所周知的。

sentences.en: On Mondays, they were both scheduled to attend a midday lecture on mobile and satellite communication systeMs.
sentences.zh: 星期一，他们俩都计划参加一场关于移动和卫星通信系统的午间讲座。

sentences.en: The two typically woke up at around 8am, prepared for the day, and then studied for a couple of hours, before walking to the lecture hall together.
sentences.zh: 两人通常在早上8点左右起床，为新的一天做准备，然后学习几个小时，接着一起步行去演讲厅。

sentences.en: The campus was only about a five minute walk from their home, and they always made the journey on foot.
sentences.zh: 校园距离他们的住所只有大约五分钟的步行路程，他们总是步行出行。

sentences.en: A forensic examination of Tony's computer, which was in his bedroom, revealed he'd spent Monday morning at home working on his thesis.
sentences.zh: 对托尼卧室里的电脑进行法证检验后发现，他周一上午一直在家写毕业论文。

sentences.en: He sent two emails to his supervisor, the first at 10.42am and the second at 11.06am, before manually shutting the computer down at 12.02pm.
sentences.zh: 他给导师发了两封电子邮件，第一封在上午10点42分，第二封在上午11点06分，随后在中午12点02分手动关闭了电脑。

sentences.en: As fastidious students, Tony and Chia Liang both valued punctuality and were always on time for classes.
sentences.zh: 作为严谨的学生，托尼和谢良（Chia Liang）都很重视守时，上课从未迟到过。

sentences.en: However, several classmates told the police that on Monday September 15,
sentences.zh: 然而，几位同班同学告诉警方，在9月15日星期一这天，

sentences.en: Tony showed up for the 12pm lecture around 15 minutes late and alone.
sentences.zh: 托尼大约迟到了15分钟，独自一人出现在中午12点的讲座上。

sentences.en: His usually neat, gelled hair was messy and dishevelled.
sentences.zh: 他平时整洁、抹了发胶的头发显得凌乱不堪。

sentences.en: Some classmates noticed that he seemed distracted, restless and tired.
sentences.zh: 一些同学注意到他似乎有些心神不宁、坐立不安而且十分疲惫。

sentences.en: When one of them asked Tony why he was late, he smiled vaguely, but said nothing.
sentences.zh: 当其中一人问托尼为什么迟到时，他含糊地笑了一下，什么也没说。

sentences.en: He didn't seem to be paying attention to the lecture, instead turning his head and looking around as though keeping an eye out for someone.
sentences.zh: 他似乎并没有在听讲座，而是不断转头四顾，就像在留意什么人一样。

sentences.en: Unusually, Chia Liang didn't show up at all.
sentences.zh: 反常的是，谢良压根没有出现。

sentences.en: Tony and Chia Liang had arranged to meet with a classmate named Kevin after the lecture to organise an ethics seminar they'd been working on together.
sentences.zh: 托尼和谢良原本安排在讲座结束后与一名叫凯文的同学会面，商讨他们一直在合作筹备的一个伦理学研讨会。

sentences.en: But during the lecture, Tony lent over to Kevin and told him they had to cancel the meeting.
sentences.zh: 但在讲座期间，托尼俯身对凯文说，他们不得不取消这次会面。

sentences.en: He gave no explanation as to why, simply saying that Chia Liang had something he needed to do.
sentences.zh: 他没有解释原因，只是说谢良有点事要处理。

sentences.en: The lecture finished a little early, at around 1.50pm.
sentences.zh: 讲座提前了一会儿结束，大约在下午1点50分。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Tony chatted to some classmates and they noticed he appeared uneasy.
sentences.zh: 之后，托尼和几位同学闲聊，大家注意到他显得很不自在。

sentences.en: He was shaking from side to side.
sentences.zh: 他身体左右摇晃着。

sentences.en: One friend asked what was going on, and Tony responded that he urgently needed to go to the toilet.
sentences.zh: 有个朋友问怎么回事，托尼回答说他急着去洗手间。

sentences.en: Other classmates noted that Tony seemed tired, but otherwise normal.
sentences.zh: 其他同学则注意到托尼看起来很疲惫，但除此之外一切正常。

sentences.en: He told one of them that he was going home to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他告诉其中一人，他要回家睡觉。

sentences.en: Tony then left the lecture hall and began walking up the outdoor staircase that led off campus towards the corner of Oval Lane and Willis Street.
sentences.zh: 随后，托尼离开演讲厅，沿着通往校外卵石巷（Oval Lane）和威利斯街（Willis Street）转角处的室外楼梯走去。

sentences.en: This was a well-used pathway for students coming and going from the university and was the usual route Tony walked home.
sentences.zh: 这是学生们进出学校常走的一条路，也是托尼步行回家的惯常路线。

sentences.en: Just before 2pm, he passed a friend named Jonathan who asked, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 就在下午2点前，他遇到了一个叫乔纳森（Jonathan）的朋友，对方问他怎么样？

sentences.en: Instead of responding with his typical friendly smile and a warm reply,
sentences.zh: 托尼没有像往常那样露出友好的微笑并热情回应，

sentences.en: Tony grunted, it's going good, before continuing on his way.
sentences.zh: 而是咕哝了一句“挺好的”，然后继续赶路。

sentences.en: Jonathan watched as Tony made his way towards a vehicle parked near the top of the steps on Willis Street.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森看着托尼走向停在威利斯街台阶顶端附近的一辆汽车。

sentences.en: Jonathan remembered it because the car was facing the wrong way in the one-way street and was also parked in front of a no-stopping sign.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森之所以记得这辆车，是因为在这条单行道上它开错了方向，而且还停在禁停标志的前面。

sentences.en: He could see two or three other people inside the car, all of them Asian, none of whom he recognised.
sentences.zh: 他看到车里还有两三个人，全都是亚洲面孔，他一个都不认识。

sentences.en: Jonathan was with his friend Sean who saw the car and its occupants too.
sentences.zh: 当时乔纳森和他的朋友肖恩（Sean）在一起，肖恩也看到了这辆车和车里的人。

sentences.en: Sean remembered Tony taking his backpack off and approaching the car's open door.
sentences.zh: 肖恩记得托尼取下了双肩包，走近车子打开的车门。

sentences.en: Tony got into the car, which Jonathan noted as odd because he knew Tony lived in close walking distance to the campus.
sentences.zh: 托尼上了车，乔纳森觉得这很反常，因为他知道托尼就住在离校园步行几分钟的地方。

sentences.en: He then watched as the car drove away with Tony inside.
sentences.zh: 接着他眼看着汽车载着托尼驶离了。

sentences.en: Police could find no explanation as to why Chao Leung hadn't attended uni that day.
sentences.zh: 警方无法解释为什么周良（Chao Leung）那天没有去学校。

sentences.en: At the time he was killed, he'd been wearing trousers and a jumper with his wallet in his back pocket.
sentences.zh: 他遇害时穿着长裤和套头衫，后裤兜里放着钱包。

sentences.en: Those who knew Chao Leung said that was how he dressed when he left the house.
sentences.zh: 认识周良的人说，他出门时就是这样穿的。

sentences.en: If he was hanging around at home, he just wore shorts and a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 如果他闲呆在家裏，就只穿短裤和T恤。

sentences.en: The fact that he was dressed suggested that he was either preparing to leave the house or perhaps expecting company.
sentences.zh: 他穿戴整齐这一事实表明，他要么正准备出门，要么就是在等什么人登门。

sentences.en: Chao Leung's computer was last used at 11.58am.
sentences.zh: 周良的电脑最后一次使用是在上午11点58分。

sentences.en: The blood spatter and positioning of his body behind the couch indicated that he'd been sitting at the low computer table at around this time
sentences.zh: 沙发后面的血迹喷溅痕迹和尸体的位置表明，大约在这个时间，他正坐在矮电脑桌旁，

sentences.en: when someone came up and unexpectedly hit his head from behind with a blunt object.
sentences.zh: 这时有人走近，冷不防用钝器从后面击中了她的头部。

sentences.en: The tip of his left index finger was crushed to the point of almost being amputated, suggesting that he'd put his hand up to his head after the first blow,
sentences.zh: 他左手食指尖碎裂，几乎被截断，这表明他在遭受第一击后曾举手护头，

sentences.en: at which point he was struck again.
sentences.zh: 就在这时他再次遭到袭击。

sentences.en: The force of these two blows was extreme enough to fracture Chao Leung's skull and cause brain damage.
sentences.zh: 这两击的力度极大，不仅砸碎了周良的头骨，还造成了脑损伤。

sentences.en: Further examination of his brain revealed a substance called amyloid precursor protein.
sentences.zh: 对他的大脑进一步检验发现了一种名为淀粉样前体蛋白的物质。

sentences.en: More commonly known as beta-APP, this substance only forms when at least two hours have passed between a brain injury being inflicted and the individual's time of death.
sentences.zh: 这种物质更常被称为beta-APP，只有在脑部受创与个人死亡之间过去至少两小时的情况下才会形成。

sentences.en: The presence of beta-APP indicated that Chao Leung hadn't died instantly, but had survived for at least two hours after he was first struck in the head.
sentences.zh: beta-APP的存在表明，周良并非当场死亡，而是头部首次受击后至少存活了两小时。

sentences.en: This was a significant finding for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于几个原因，这是一个重大的发现。

sentences.en: First, the last confirmed sighting of Tony was at 2pm and Ram's call to emergency services was placed at 2.20pm.
sentences.zh: 首先，有确切目击记录的托尼最后现身时间是下午2点，而拉姆（Ram）拨打急救电话的时间是下午2点20分。

sentences.en: This meant that Tony was attacked during that short window of time, while Chao Leung was attacked around midday.
sentences.zh: 这意味着托尼是在那短短的窗口期内遭到袭击的，而周良则是在中午左右遇袭的。

sentences.en: It also explained why the five stab wounds in Chao Leung's neck hadn't bled much and why no blood was found in his lungs.
sentences.zh: 这也解释了为什么周良颈部的五处刀伤没有流很多血，以及为什么他的肺部没有发现血迹。

sentences.en: Investigators believed that these stab wounds hadn't been inflicted at the same time as the blows to Chao Leung's head,
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，这些刀伤并非与周良头部受击同时发生，

sentences.en: but hours later, when he was either on the brink of death or post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 而是在数小时后，当他处于濒死状态或死后才造成的。

sentences.en: Based on the forensic evidence, investigators believed that Tony returned home through the front door.
sentences.zh: 根据法医证据，调查人员认为托尼是从前门回家的。

sentences.en: If he'd entered via the back door, he would have instantly come across Chao Leung's body lying behind the couch.
sentences.zh: 如果他是从后门进入的，就会一眼看到倒在沙发后面的周良的尸体。

sentences.en: Yet, when police first arrived at the crime scene, they'd found a pot of chicken wings cooking on the stove, indicating that Tony had started preparing his lunch
sentences.zh: 然而，当警察最初抵达犯罪现场时，他们发现炉子上正煮着一锅鸡翅，这表明托尼开始准备午饭时

sentences.en: without suspecting anything was amiss.
sentences.zh: 根本没有察觉到有任何不对劲。

sentences.en: He'd also taken his shoes off and put his wallet in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他还脱下了鞋子，把钱包放回了卧室。

sentences.en: From the kitchen, Tony likely made his way to the lounge room where the attacker hit him head on, smashing his glasses to pieces.
sentences.zh: 托尼很可能是从厨房走向起居室的，凶手在那里正面袭击了他，把他的眼镜砸得粉碎。

sentences.en: At least two blows were administered with such force that Tony's nose was fractured, all eight of his front teeth were knocked out, and his jaw was broken.
sentences.zh: 袭击者下手极狠，至少实施了两次重击，导致托尼鼻骨骨折、全部八颗门牙脱落、下巴粉碎。

sentences.en: Blood smears, footprints, and displaced furniture indicated that he'd then fallen to the ground, but managed to get up and run down the hallway in an attempt to escape.
sentences.zh: 血迹、脚印和移位的家具表明，他当时倒在了地上，但随后设法站起身，顺着走廊逃跑。

sentences.en: There, the offender struck Tony in the head several more times, causing at least 12 lacerations and massive skull fractures.
sentences.zh: 凶手在那里又多次击打托尼的头部，造成至少12处撕裂伤和严重的头骨骨折。

sentences.en: Bruises on Tony's arms indicated he'd tried to defend himself, but the ferocity of the attack had rendered him powerless.
sentences.zh: 托尼手臂上的淤青表明他曾试图反抗，但攻击的狂暴让他无力招架。

sentences.en: While his head injuries were severe enough to ensure death, five stab wounds were also found on the right side of Tony's neck,
sentences.zh: 尽管他的头部伤势足以致命，但在托尼右侧颈部也发现了五处刀伤，

sentences.en: inflicted one below the other in a brisk, frenzied attack.
sentences.zh: 这是一次接一次、迅猛而狂乱的连续刺击。

sentences.en: The evidence at the crime scene was disturbing and perplexing.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场的证据令人不安且困惑不解。

sentences.en: If Charlie Young was first attacked at midday, then it meant he lay dying for two hours while the offender either lay in wait or left
sentences.zh: 如果查理·杨（Charlie Young）在中午首次遇袭，那就意味着他在痛苦中濒死挣扎了两小时，而凶手要么在一旁潜伏等待，要么离开

sentences.en: and then returned to kill Tony shortly after 2pm.
sentences.zh: 并在下午2点刚过时折返杀害了托尼。

sentences.en: At that point, the offender might have detected a sign of life in Charlie Young and stabbed him in the neck to ensure he was dead.
sentences.zh: 在那时，凶手可能察觉到查理·杨还有生命迹象，于是捅了他的脖子以确保他彻底死去。

sentences.en: Yet, strangely enough, while the baseball bat and knife found next to Tony's body showed traces of Tony's blood and DNA, there wasn't a single spot of Charlie Young's blood or DNA
sentences.zh: 然而诡异的是，尽管在托尼尸体旁发现的棒球棒和刀具上带有托尼的血迹和DNA，但在两件凶器上

sentences.en: found on either weapon.
sentences.zh: 却没有找到一丝查理·杨的血迹或DNA。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目赞助商的广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《案卷》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: The evidence at the Barker Street crime scene left investigators with more questions than answers, the most obvious being, why would anyone want these young men dead?
sentences.zh: 巴克街（Barker Street）犯罪现场的证据给调查人员留下了比答案更多的疑问，最明显的一个就是：为什么会有人想要这些年轻人的命？

sentences.en: By all accounts,
sentences.zh: 据各方所述，

sentences.en: Tae Chao Leung and Tony Tan Po Chuan were quiet, polite and intelligent students who kept a low profile while focusing on their education.
sentences.zh: 戴朝良（Tae Chao Leung）和陈宝权（Tony Tan Po Chuan）都是安静、礼貌且聪明的学生，他们保持低调，专心学业。

sentences.en: They were dutiful sons who valued their families, with Tony's mother saying that Tony would always help others, including his friends.
sentences.zh: 他们是孝顺且看重家庭的儿子，托尼的母亲说托尼总是乐于助人，对朋友也很好。

sentences.en: Both men lived off modest allowances and nothing was missing to indicate robbery as a motive.
sentences.zh: 两人都靠着微薄的生活费过活，现场也没有丢失任何物品，这排除了谋杀劫财的动机。

sentences.en: A friend of Tony's told the police,
sentences.zh: 托尼的一位朋友告诉警方，

sentences.en: Police considered whether the attacks could have been racially motivated.
sentences.zh: 警方考虑了袭击是否具有种族仇恨动机。

sentences.en: There had been a recent wave of kidnappings and extortion attempts against Asian students in New South Wales, the most recent having occurred just weeks prior.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州近期发生了一系列针对亚裔学生的绑架和勒索未遂事件，最近的一起就发生在几周前。

sentences.en: A 19-year-old Vietnamese student was strangled to death after a botched kidnapping attempt, while a Chinese student had been kidnapped and assaulted
sentences.zh: 一名19岁的越南籍学生在一次绑架未遂后被勒死，而另一名中国籍学生则遭到绑架和袭击，

sentences.en: while the perpetrators demanded a $120,000 ransom from her parents in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 当时绑匪向她在北京的父母勒索12万美元的赎金。

sentences.en: But investigators found no evidence to support such a motive and it was quickly ruled out, leaving them to comb through the men's personal lives
sentences.zh: 但调查人员没有找到支持这种动机的证据，该假设很快被排除，这迫使他们开始梳理这两名男子的私生活，

sentences.en: in an attempt to discover what, if any, secrets they'd been hiding.
sentences.zh: 试图弄清他们究竟隐瞒了什么秘密（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: It was common for young Singaporean men to marry before moving overseas to complete their tertiary education.
sentences.zh: 年轻的新加坡男子在出国完成高等教育前结婚是很常见的现象。

sentences.en: Tony had met his girlfriend in an online chat room in 1998 and the two wed in Singapore just a few months before his murder.
sentences.zh: 托尼于1998年在网络聊天室里认识了他的女朋友，两人在他遇害前几个月在新加坡登记结婚。

sentences.en: She had visited Sydney and stayed with Tony at Barker Street.
sentences.zh: 她曾访问悉尼，并与托尼一起住在巴克街。

sentences.en: When questioned by police, she couldn't think of anyone who would wish Tony harm.
sentences.zh: 面对警方盘问，她想不出有谁会想要害托尼。

sentences.en: A forensic examination of Tony's computer didn't reveal evidence of infidelity, criminal activity, or anything to suggest that he felt he was in danger.
sentences.zh: 对托尼电脑的法证检查并未发现他有不忠、违法犯罪的迹象，也没有任何迹象表明他觉得自己身处危险之中。

sentences.en: However, the search of Tay Chao Leung's computer was a different story.
sentences.zh: 然而，对戴朝良电脑的搜查却是另一回事。

sentences.en: Chao Leung was married to a woman named Winnie who was also back in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 朝良和一个名叫温妮（Winnie）的女子结了婚，温妮当时也在新加坡。

sentences.en: The two met in high school and married in a registry wedding, but they'd been planning a proper wedding celebration after Chao Leung completed his degree and moved back home.
sentences.zh: 两人在高中相识并在注册处结了婚，但他们计划等朝良完成学业回国后，再办一场像样的婚礼。

sentences.en: Tony's wife told police that when she was visiting Barker Street, she'd noticed that Chao Leung didn't wear his wedding ring.
sentences.zh: 托尼的妻子告诉警方，她造访巴克街时，曾注意到朝良不戴结婚戒指。

sentences.en: He only put it on when Winnie came to visit.
sentences.zh: 只有温妮来探访时，他才会戴上。

sentences.en: Chao Leung's online activity revealed that he'd spent the last few months before his death in almost daily contact with another woman in Singapore named Jasmine.
sentences.zh: 朝良的网络活动显示，在遇害前的几个月里，他几乎每天都在和新加坡的另一个名叫杰丝敏（Jasmine）的女人保持联系。

sentences.en: While it was mostly just a day-to-day chit-chat, their online conversations were often flirtatious and occasionally sexual.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多只是日常闲聊，但他们的网聊内容常常带有调情意味，偶尔还涉及性话题。

sentences.en: Chao Leung made it clear that he was attracted to Jasmine and had romantic feelings for her, even though she was engaged to be married.
sentences.zh: 朝良明确表示自己被杰丝敏吸引并对她动了真情，尽管当时杰丝敏已经订婚。

sentences.en: Police wondered if jealousy could have played a role in the double homicide.
sentences.zh: 警方不禁怀疑嫉妒是否在这起双重谋杀案中扮演了某种角色。

sentences.en: They conducted searches with immigration, but these only proved that neither Jasmine nor her boyfriend were in Australia at the time of the murders.
sentences.zh: 他们向移民部门进行了查询，但结果证明杰丝敏及其男友在谋杀发生时都不在澳大利亚。

sentences.en: With no obvious suspects or motives, police turned their focus to the mysterious car on Willis Street that Tony's uni mates, Jonathan and Sean,
sentences.zh: 在没有明显嫌疑人或动机的情况下，警方将焦点转向了威利斯街上那辆神秘的汽车——托尼的大学同学乔纳森和肖恩

sentences.en: had seen him enter mere minutes before he was killed.
sentences.zh: 在托尼遇害前几分钟，曾亲眼看到他上了这辆车。

sentences.en: Tony accepting a ride home instead of walking was so out of character that police were convinced it was significant.
sentences.zh: 托尼放弃步行改坐顺风车回家，这太不符合他的性格了，以至于警方确信这其中必有重大隐情。

sentences.en: Either the people in the car had something to do with the murders or they might have witnessed something crucial that could hold the key to solving the case.
sentences.zh: 车里的人要么与谋杀案有关，要么可能目击了某些关键线索，而这可能是破案的关键所在。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Willis Street wasn't covered by the university's CCTV cameras and the descriptions of the vehicle varied.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，威利斯街不在大学闭路电视的监控范围内，而且对该车辆的描述也各不相同。

sentences.en: Jonathan described it as a white four-door sedan, possibly a Toyota Echo, while Sean said it was dark in colour.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森将其描述为一辆白色四门轿车，可能是一辆丰田威姿（Toyota Echo），而肖恩则说车身颜色较深。

sentences.en: Police spent hours driving the two young men around the area to see if they could spot a similar-looking car, but it was a fruitless endeavour.
sentences.zh: 警方花了数小时开车带着这两名年轻人在这片区域兜风，看能否认出外观相似的车，但最终一无所获。

sentences.en: As for the occupants of the vehicle, all Jonathan or Sean could say was that they appeared to be Asian.
sentences.zh: 至于车里的人，乔纳森和肖恩唯一能说的是他们看起来像是亚洲人。

sentences.en: A man who lived near the victims told the police that he saw a pale-coloured car parked in a laneway near Barker Street sometime after 1pm on the day in question.
sentences.zh: 一名住在受害人附近的男子告诉警方，案发当天下午1点过后，他看到一辆浅色汽车停在巴克街附近的一条小巷里。

sentences.en: At around 2.25pm, a university student was driving down Barker Street looking for a park when he saw an olive-skinned man who was, quote, not Indian or Caucasian, looking around
sentences.zh: 下午2点25分左右，一名大学生正开车沿着巴克街寻找停车位，突然看到一个肤色较深、用他话说“既不是印度人也不是高加索人”的男子一边四处张望，

sentences.en: as he made his way towards a small white sedan parked next door to the murder scene.
sentences.zh: 一边朝着停在谋杀现场隔壁的一辆白色小轿车走去。

sentences.en: The man, who appeared to be in his early 30s, got into the car and it drove away.
sentences.zh: 这名男子看上去三十岁出头，上了车后车便开走了。

sentences.en: Another woman described seeing a similar car driving erratically about 2km from Barker Street at around 2.30pm.
sentences.zh: 另一名女子描述说，在下午2点30分左右，看到一辆类似的汽车在距离巴克街约2公里的地方疯狂行驶。

sentences.en: She estimated that the vehicle was going 100km per hour in a 50 zone.
sentences.zh: 她估计这辆车在限速50的区域里开到了100公里每小时。

sentences.en: It almost hit another car as well as a telegraph pole.
sentences.zh: 它差点撞上一辆车和一根电线杆。

sentences.en: The woman told the police,
sentences.zh: 这名女子告诉警方，

sentences.en: It wasn't just joyriders, the speed scared me.
sentences.zh: 这可不仅仅是飙车兜风，那个速度把我吓坏了。

sentences.en: I had never witnessed this sort of behaviour on the road before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未在路上见过这种行为。

sentences.en: As weeks passed with no breakthroughs in the case, the police made a public appeal for the driver of the car to come forward.
sentences.zh: 随着几周过去，案件仍无突破，警方公开呼吁该车的司机主动现身。

sentences.en: They said the man had picked Tony up less than 30 minutes before his body was found and that he could be the vital link in solving the murders.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这名男子在托尼被发现尸体不到30分钟前搭载了他，他可能是破获这起谋杀案的关键纽带。

sentences.en: The car was described as light blue or white and resembling a Toyota Echo.
sentences.zh: 这辆车被描述为浅蓝色或白色，类似于丰田威姿。

sentences.en: Anyone who had seen a similar vehicle around Barker Street was encouraged to contact the police.
sentences.zh: 警方鼓励任何在巴克街附近见过类似车辆的人与警方联系。

sentences.en: No one came forward, prompting police to issue an international press release.
sentences.zh: 然而无人出面，促使警方发布了国际新闻稿。

sentences.en: But still, the car and its occupants remained a mystery.
sentences.zh: 但那辆车及其乘员依然是个谜。

sentences.en: Weeks turned into months with the unsolved case receiving little attention from the Australian media.
sentences.zh: 几周变成了几个月，这起未破的悬案几乎没有引起澳大利亚媒体的关注。

sentences.en: By May 2004, eight months had passed and the killer was still yet to be apprehended.
sentences.zh: 到了2004年5月，八个月已经过去，凶手依然逍遥法外。

sentences.zh: 拉姆·图亚里（Ram Tuari）联系警方，告知他们自己打算返回新加坡。

sentences.en: He told them that his studies hadn't been going well and there were commitments he needed to fulfil back at home.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，他的学业一直不太顺利，国内还有一些责任需要他去履行。

sentences.en: Ram hadn't booked his flight yet but he wanted to check if the police needed anything further from him before he left.
sentences.zh: 拉姆还没有订机票，但他想确认在离开前警方是否还需要他协助调查。

sentences.en: The detectives working the case asked Ram to visit the police station the following morning for one final interview.
sentences.zh: 负责该案的侦探要求拉姆第二天上午去警察局接受最后一次面谈。

sentences.en: Ram agreed.
sentences.zh: 拉姆同意了。

sentences.en: When he showed up the next day as planned, the detectives read him his rights and then sat him down for a second recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 当他第二天按计划现身时，侦探向他宣读了权利，随后坐下来对他进行了第二次录音盘问。

sentences.en: What Ram didn't realise was that he wasn't being interviewed as a witness but as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 拉姆没有意识到的是，他这次接受盘问的身份不是证人，而是嫌疑人。

sentences.en: For some time, detectives had been dubious of Ram's claims that he'd slept through the attacks committed right outside his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 一段时间以来，侦探们一直对拉姆的说法持怀疑态度，他声称自己对发生在卧室门外的袭击睡得死死的。

sentences.en: While they'd initially been willing to accept this, this changed after forensic evidence indicated two hours passed between the two attacks.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们最初愿意接受这一说法，但在法证证据表明两次袭击之间间隔了两个小时后，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: Detectives didn't think it made sense for an outsider to enter the apartment, pludgeon

sentences.zh: 查理·杨然后离开，几个小时后又返回对托尼发动第二次袭击，这在逻辑上说不通。

sentences.zh: 拉姆身高六英尺，是一名受过训练的突击队员，被

sentences.zh: 弗兰茨（Franz）形容为有点大男子主义。

sentences.en: Why then would he barricade himself in his room knowing that his friend was outside screaming for help?
sentences.zh: 既然如此，为什么在明知朋友在外面尖叫求救的情况下，他还要把自己反锁在房间里呢？

sentences.en: The fact that there was no sign of forced entry or robbery also raised suspicion, suggesting that the crimes might have been committed by someone who either lived there
sentences.zh: 现场没有强行闯入或抢劫的痕迹，这也引起了怀疑，表明这些罪行可能是由居住在那里的人

sentences.en: or was welcomed inside.
sentences.zh: 或者被迎进屋内的人犯下的。

sentences.en: Given how bloody the scene was, it stood to reason that whoever carried out the attacks would have also been covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 鉴于现场血迹斑斑，理性推断，无论谁实施了袭击，身上也必然沾满血迹。

sentences.zh: 侦探们认为这是因为凶手在离开前清洗过。

sentences.zh: 他说，当他去检查托尼的脉搏时，托尼咳嗽了一声，鲜血从他嘴里喷涌而出。

sentences.zh: 调查人员觉得这极其可疑。

sentences.zh: 首先，这是拉姆第一次提到这件事。

sentences.zh: 他在第一次接受警方讯问时对此闭口不谈。
